purpose: Current-branch overrides through 1944-04-30; preserves v001 rules and adds adjudication/state/global-propagation/ASW KPI rules.

replaces_runtime_behavior: COMSEC-1942-HIGH-GRADE-OUTCOME=OPEN as an automatic runtime reopen
overrides.effective_rule: In 1942 Japanese high-grade naval plaintext is not available to US forces at strategically useful time/precision under normal conditions. Low-grade/plaintext/traffic/DF/recon/submarine/geographic-logistic inference remain active.
sources: 70_暗号・通信情報_設計防御・攻撃・運用.md
invalidation_if_changed: CHECKPOINT_1942-05-06T24_v001 and all descendants where COMINT affected observation/decision

replaces_runtime_behavior: opening_sync_state legacy Pearl pointer to v002
overrides.effective_rule: Pearl opening sync uses pearl_state_transition_v003 for execution; v001/v002 remain diagnostic/archive.

Do not infer combat strength from nationality/year labels. Adjudicate actual present weapons, immediate readiness, crew/pilot median, information loop, maintenance regeneration, doctrine/training, enemy countertechnology, and allocation.
overrides.reason: Prevents silent historical under/over-performance inheritance when branch technology, losses and institutions diverge.

overrides.effective_rule: Separate existence, availability, readiness, mission set, mission effectiveness and allocation. A completed hull/prototype/airframe is not automatically a first-line combat asset.
overrides.reason: Critical from 1943-44 as Taiho, N1K2-J, A7M, Ki-67, turbojet, I-400/Seiran and other systems overlap in different maturity states.

overrides.effective_rule: Remote events may retain historical skeleton with bounded timing/loss changes; indirectly connected events must recalc dates/allocations/decisions; directly connected events must be fully recalculated. Check other theaters every 10-14 days before advancing.
overrides.reason: Avoids freezing Europe/China/Burma while Pacific changes consume the same ships, aircraft, landing craft, reserves and political attention.

overrides.effective_rule: For ASW track detection, datum maintenance, weapon delivery, damage, mission kill and kill separately. MAD/radar improvements primarily increase datum maintenance and weapon-delivery opportunities; do not multiply confirmed sinkings by the same factor.
overrides.reason: Prevents over-crediting Tokai/MAD while preserving their large effect on denied attacks and hunter-killer trial count.

edit_protocol: Create a new override revision; do not rewrite old evidence. Re-run only checkpoints listed by dependency/invalidation maps.
